# Support Hub

> Support Hub is a customer support workspace that unifies email, live chat and voice conversations with marketing campaigns, operations and analytics.

Support Hub is used by support teams to handle customer interactions across
channels in one place: shared email inboxes, live chat, phone calls, AI-assisted
replies, knowledge management, marketing outreach and operational case handling.

Almost all pages require an authenticated agent account, so there is no public
content to crawl beyond the entry page.

## Pages

- [Support Hub](/): Sign-in entry point to the Support Hub workspace.
